en: Sepia-toned colonial-era hunting scene showing a dead hippopotamus lying in shallow water in the foreground. Behind it stands a group of local African men with paddles and spears, and several European men in light clothing on a wooden boat. The printed image occupies the upper part of the card, with ample blank space below for writing. Text is printed in red beneath the image and vertically along the left side.
